Wait for spontaneous delivery; avoid oxytocin in the meantime

Multiparity; epidural increases the forceps rate but not caesarean
Diabetes in pregnancy; epidural reduces the caesarean section rate

Bandl's: oxytocin overdose; Schroeder's: obstructed labour

Bandl's: uterine rupture; Schroeder's: placenta accreta spectrum

opts: Cervical length under 25 mm on ultrasound, with emergency cerclage

Any normal pregnancy, given routinely as a prophylactic measure

exp: In the source notes a tocolytic is used with cerclage only when the ultrasound cervical length is below 25 mm and the cerclage is an emergency one.

opts: Partial extension; anterior fontanelle (diamond) and supraorbital ridges
Complete extension; the mentum and the nose of the fetus
Complete flexion; the posterior fontanelle and sagittal suture
Deflexion; both fontanelles felt with the orbital ridges
exp: Brow presentation occurs with partial extension of the head; on P/V the anterior fontanelle (diamond shaped) and the supraorbital ridges are felt.

opts: Reduced amniotic fluid because the membranes have ruptured
Polyhydramnios from accumulation of the leaking fluid
Normal amniotic fluid volume is always seen in these cases
A snowstorm appearance throughout the uterine cavity

opts: They displace bilirubin from albumin, precipitating neonatal kernicterus

opts: Twin pregnancy with the 1st twin cephalic and the 2nd in transverse lie
Singleton frank breech presenting at term in a primigravida
A footling breech in a primigravida at term, before labour
A preterm breech presenting before 34 completed weeks of gestation

opts: Midway between the pubic symphysis and the sacral promontory

Closer to the sacral promontory than to the pubic symphysis
In the anteroposterior diameter, not the transverse diameter

Evaluation of the fetal risk of an open neural tube defect
Measurement of maternal serum human placental lactogen levels

exp: Incomplete forward rotation achieves only one-eighth rotation (ROP to ROT); the causes are the android pelvis (commonest), a big baby and reduced liquor.
